title: Stoner Dark
description: This Resorce Pack Is Custom Good GUI For Minecraft
body:
Stoner is a sleek, modern, and high-contrast Dark UI resource pack designed to provide a clean and eye-straining-free experience for Minecraft players. Heavily inspired by the "Bare Bones" and "Default Dark Mode" aesthetics, Stoner focuses on simplifying the interface while maintaining a bold, professional look. For More professional look is (font) [Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stonerfont)

📁 Versions History

    v1.0: First stable release.

    v1.12: Added Bare Bones style elements.

    v1.13.5:

        🗑️ Removed Bare Bones blocks and items to keep the pack focused on UI.

        🍞 Added custom Toasts (pop-up notifications).

        🖼️ Replaced the classic Minecraft icon with the official Stoner icon.

    v1.13.8:

        ⏸️ Added the Stoner Pause Menu icon (Available in the "Icons" resource pack).
        v1.14.1:🖱️Aded Castom Cursor.
        
        v1.14.6:🖼️Replaced Apple Skin Hanger Textures and Mod Menu buttons and inventory management
        v1.14.8:📙Aded Book and Quill GUI
        v1.14.9:Replaced Stoner Logo to Minecraft Style
        v1.16.8:

        🌄 Added a fully custom, seamless Main Menu Panorama background using vanilla debug rendering.

        🏹 Redesigned GUI progress arrows (Furnace, Crafting, etc.) for a sharper dark look.

        📖 Overhauled the Recipe Book overlay and container menus to match the high-contrast UI theme.

😎 Pro tip: The Light version of Stoner is also [Available Now](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stoner-light)!
💡 Features Overview

Eye-Friendly: High-contrast dark themes crafted specifically to reduce eye strain during long gaming sessions.

Clean & Minimal: Unnecessary clutter removed to give you a modern, performance-friendly interface.

    Mod Support: Custom UI textures for popular optimization and HUD mods.
😎 Pro tip: the Light version of Stoner is [Available Now](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stoner-light)
